title: NSClient Dev-l not syncing on profile switch cancelation
symptom: After changing profile to 150% and syncing to NSClient, automation canceled the high profile to 100% but NSClient did not update, remaining frozen on 150%. Manual switch to 100% on NSClient also failed. There was also a small IOB deviation (0.01U on AAPS vs Neg. IOB on NSClient).
cause: The issue was not definitively identified by the thread. MilosKozak suggested a bug in Nightscout master and recommended using the dev branch, but the user later found that a corrupted installation on their phone was the cause.
fix: The user fixed the issue by building and installing NSClient2, which worked fine. They stated that something was corrupted on the previous installation.
evidence_quote: Issue fixed. Built and installed NSClient2 which works fine. Apparently something was corrupted on previous installation.
